title: Tyler
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 7 muscle-ups and 21 sumo deadlift high pulls, for time. Honours U.S. Army 1st Lt. Tyler E. Parten, killed by RPG and small-arms fire in Konar Province, Afghanistan, in 2009. The high pulls fatigue the same pulling muscles as the muscle-ups, so plan the sets.
